name: Spin Master Corp.
summary: Spin Master Corp., a children's entertainment company, engages in the creation, design, manufacture, licensing, and marketing of various toys, entertainment products, and digital games in North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Toys, Entertainment, and Digital Games. The Toys segment offers preschool, infant and toddler, and plush products; activities, games and puzzles, and dolls; wheels and action products; and outdoor products. The Entertainment segment engages in the creation and production of multi-platform content, as well as non-toy consumer products, including apparel and other consumer goods, and publishing and live entertainment.
